profiles.method: Modelled: a straight line from the measured ground where the Manhattan-bound roadway's approach leaves Adams St in Brooklyn to a crest of 41.5 m at mid-span, then a straight line down across the Manhattan approach and the exit ramp loop to the FDR Drive, where the course rejoins measured ground. The real deck is a gentle curve between the towers, so the grade near the ends is somewhat steeper than modelled.
profiles.name: Brooklyn Bridge and the exit ramp to the FDR Drive
profiles.source: Mid-span roadway 136 ft (41.5 m) at mile 5 on the organiser's 2026 course elevation chart; ends follow the measured approaches (USGS 3DEP lidar, NY CMPG 2013); positions from OpenStreetMap
